snippet.title: Open Waters - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4623300/Open_Waters/

Open Waters is a first-person ocean survival horror game. Stranded in a small boat, you must navigate treacherous waters, evade creatures of the deep, and find your way back to safety before the ocean drags you into its depths.
